description.en: Aggregate, non-personal notes of what customers ask, report or want, one row per note, for every product; the table the support team's contract serves the company.
description.vi: Ghi nhận không danh tính điều khách hỏi, báo hoặc muốn của mọi sản phẩm, mỗi dòng một ý; bảng mà hợp đồng của đội hỗ trợ chia sẻ cho công ty.

tools.description: File ONE row of customer feedback in the voice-of-customer table: the product it is about, its kind and a one-line summary of the THEME in your own words. The row is shared with the company, so it must carry no customer identity: no name, email, phone, handle, user or conversation id, and no quoted message. Call it once per note.
tools.name: voc_record

product.description: Product id (lohi, 2novel, 2found, trysoot) or chung when it is about no single product. Defaults to the run's project.

summary.description: The theme in one line, without any personal detail.

tables.description: Themes customers asked, reported or wanted, one row per note, without identity.
tables.name: voc
